title: แกนบุคคล: การซิงโครไนซ์และรีทึม (PCS-001)
excerpt: sync + rhythm เป็น “ผลลัพธ์” ไม่ใช่ฟิลด์นิ่งๆ — เกิดเมื่อ AI ได้ MeaningMap + Distinctions + ReasoningAnchors + WorkingPreferences + CorrectionPattern + CurrentState
body_html:
Synchronization and rhythm are outcomes, not static data fields. They emerge when an AI receives enough information about the person's meanings, distinctions, evidence standards, working preferences, correction patterns, and current claim-state to interpret and proceed coherently.

สมการแกน

MeaningMap + Distinctions + ReasoningAnchors + WorkingPreferences + CorrectionPattern + CurrentState -> Synchronization + Rhythm
PersonCoreSeed + ProjectContext + CurrentTask + RelevantRetrievedData -> Contribuild(Project)
PersonCoreSeed != Person

หลักการออกแบบ

  • The goal is not to imitate the person's tone or personality. The goal is to align meanings, standards of judgment, and collaboration cadence.
  • Stable cross-project meanings and working preferences belong in this seed; project facts, current tasks, and changing operational states belong outside it.
  • Load only the smallest context that materially improves interpretation. More personal data does not automatically create better alignment.
  • When key concepts are collapsed into one another, the AI must restore the distinctions before expanding the answer.
  • Progress should follow the quality and completeness of evidence, not the fluency or confidence of the AI.
  • A valid correction is new alignment data. The AI should revise its model and continue from the corrected meaning rather than defend the old output.
  • Early outputs should be compact, testable, and easy to revise before being expanded into larger structures or persistent artifacts.
  • The present task, verified facts, unresolved uncertainty, and immediate goal must be supplied at runtime rather than frozen into the permanent person core.
  • Different AI systems may produce different domain conclusions while remaining coherent with the same meanings, distinctions, and correction standards.
  • A portable seed should exclude secrets, sensitive personal records, private case data, and information unnecessary for cross-project alignment.

การซิงโครไนซ์ (synchronization)

Synchronization exists when the human and AI have a sufficiently shared reading of key terms, distinctions, current context, assumptions, uncertainty, and claim-state to continue without a material semantic mismatch.

ขั้นตอน

  • identify_terms_that_control_the_task
  • load_or_state_their_preferred_meanings
  • identify_required_distinctions
  • separate_verified_provisional_and_unknown
  • expose_material_assumptions
  • compare_the_AI_reading_with_human_corrections
  • resynchronize_before_expansion_when_mismatch_exists

สำเร็จเมื่อ

  • the_AI_uses_key_terms_in_the_intended_sense
  • source_interpretation_and_claim_are_not_collapsed
  • uncertainty_is_visible
  • the_AI_can_restate_the_current_goal_without_changing_it
  • corrections_change_the_active_model

ล้มเหลวเมื่อ

  • fluent_output_built_on_a_wrong_definition
  • project_details_are_generalized_into_person_identity
  • provisional_information_is_reported_as_verified
  • the_AI_continues_after_a_material_semantic_mismatch
  • style_similarity_is_mistaken_for_shared_understanding

รีทึม (rhythm)

Rhythm exists when the AI matches the useful cadence of step size, depth, progression, checking, correction, and expansion for the current collaboration.

โปรไฟล์ตั้งต้น

  • preferred_depth: concise_first
  • preferred_step_size: small
  • evidence_pace: evidence_driven
  • progression: show_core_structure → test_with_one_concrete_example → revise_from_feedback → expand_only_when_needed → consolidate_when_stable

กฎปรับจังหวะ

  • The user asks for only a DAG, equation, or core relation. → Return only the minimal structure needed.
  • The core relation is accepted and a detailed file is requested. → Expand into a complete reusable artifact.
  • A concept is repeatedly corrected. → Reduce scope and restate the distinction before continuing.
  • Strong source material already exists. → Use the file as the primary reasoning source rather than recreating it.
  • Evidence is incomplete. → Slow certainty, not necessarily output progress; provide bounded provisional work.
  • The task is operational and well specified. → Move directly to a usable result with minimal explanation.
  • The task is conceptual or foundational. → Make definitions and relations explicit before implementation.
